boundaries.privacy: No private source rows, names, employee IDs, flight numbers, route values or crew contents copied

realPrivateSourceRevalidation.method: Read-only original GitHub binary base64; independent RFC1951 zlib DEFLATE + Adler32, per-content-stream Tj/MCID operator census. Not semantic ToUnicode row mapping.
realPrivateSourceRevalidation.decoderFailureMode: Exactly one PDF stream-separator byte follows each compressed payload. Naively trimming all CR/LF removes a legitimate checksum byte in three source streams (one July, two August), producing false Adler failures; determine payload length or locate exact checksum, never rstrip binary bytes.

realSourceDerivedManifestCrossCheck.kind: real-original-PDF-derived metadata, not newly decoded semantic rows
realSourceDerivedManifestCrossCheck.interpretation: Monthly tail-width invariants are diagnostic layout fingerprints, not portable detectors, validated Date text, crew continuity, or evidence of year.

directCurrentCodeReview.sourceEvidenceHistoryNotice: Current scalar requiresUserNotice compares normalized values; changed fingerprint/locator with unchanged normalized value can be notice=false. Existing unit test explicitly covers new fingerprint with no notice.
directCurrentCodeReview.crewSnapshot: CrewParticipant requires name; no detached crew-snapshot receipt identity.
directCurrentCodeReview.storage: No verified CrewConnex evidence-only Sembast API; no Dart runtime test in this cycle.

parserProfileDelta.detector: Separate Skia tagged printer and PDC 14-column report family; validate exact anchors, primary Table/TR/TD/MCID, page-local provenance, nonflight/Sum boundaries, row-local source state, and binary stream length; unknown layouts fail closed.
parserProfileDelta.sourceStage: Source SHA256, profile, physical locator, raw labels and explicit missing/blank/unknown; yearless/omitted dates, publication and crew antecedent unverified => detached review.
parserProfileDelta.matching: Only unique verified active UID-owned existing Flight with independent full date+7C-specific flight+route, owner review, FlightRevision/EvidenceHead CAS and immutable receipt.
parserProfileDelta.revision: Changed source/crew with same BLH is distinct reviewable snapshot; do not use scalar SourceEvidenceHistory notice as roster revision detector.
parserProfileDelta.prohibited: No standalone FlightRecord creation, canonical Block overwrite, inferred date/PIC/SIC/PF/PM/duty/deadhead or silent snapshot replacement.

profileContract.detector: Separate Skia tagged family from PDC; typed primary Table/TR/TD and per-page MCID; validate Sum/nonflight barriers and profile version.
profileContract.rowModel: Independent DateCellState, PairingCellState and CrewCellState; direct-without-Date is a valid observed detached row, not a pipe or safe date inheritance.

profileContract.unsupported: Unknown row shape, nonflight/Sum contamination, mismatched leaf cardinality or missing anchor fails closed; zero standalone FlightRecord.
